evidence: Actual HTTP200 JavaScript-disabled Contact page describes email/phone contact details and an email-draft form, but its rendered main content has zero mailto links, zero tel links and no form. Interactive Contact has working public email/phone links; the native fallback is the affected scope.
beforeText: The contact page lists email and phone details for the maintainer. Its form opens your own email client with a prepared draft; it does not send a message automatically or store submissions on TradeHQ.
rootCause: Contact native publisher copy has no direct contact links in its links list; it refers to JavaScript form controls absent from native HTML.
skepticalPass: A working interactive form does not make the native instructions actionable. No new owner identity or contact detail is introduced: the remedy reuses contact information already intentionally published in src/pages/Contact.tsx and on the current live interactive Contact page. No claim that Google requires a no-JavaScript contact page or that this is a policy violation.
deduplication: No equivalent contact-root finding found in the 40-row historical issue430 ledger inspected or current sequential ledgers; does not relabel earlier unrelated form/provider behavior as this defect.
proposedFix: Add email and phone links already published by the owner to the existing native references, and explicitly scope the form/email-draft description to JavaScript-enabled usage. Keep email-app and copy behavior, optional direct delivery and all privacy/backend settings unchanged.
acceptance: Native Contact exposes usable mailto/tel links matching the already published interactive contact targets.
Native text accurately distinguishes direct links and JavaScript-only draft controls.
No email/call/real provider delivery or account mutation performed during validation.
Build, required exact-head checks, normal merge, Cloudflare native exact-SHA receipt, success email and fresh live reread required before fix closure.

reproduction: Actual production native HTML converts the email action to Cloudflare email protection. The local and Pages preview copies preserve the mailto target; hydrated production also restores it. With JavaScript disabled the email decoder cannot run. Body text hashes alone cannot verify link functionality.
classification: Confirmed technical defect extension; same underlying native Contact availability finding, not a second unique defect or an established Google violation.
status: PARTIAL REPAIR; NOT FIXED-RECHECKED; FOLLOWUP REQUIRED
proposedNext: Verify the vendor-supported narrowly scoped email-obfuscation exclusion for the already public Contact fallback. Preserve all global account/security/privacy settings; retest on actual custom-domain production.

proposal: Use the vendor-supported email_off HTML comment only around the Contact native publisher-note fallback, which contains the same intentionally public maintainer contact action already shipped. Other routes and Cloudflare zone/account settings remain unchanged.
whyNecessary: Production rewrites the href to a JavaScript-dependent email-protection path even though preview/local targets are correct. Without JavaScript the public native contact action remains unusable.
acceptance: Only Contact fallback receives the marker; raw compiled mailto matches existing Contact.tsx; native production after release must preserve the actual mailto rather than an email-protection URL. No message or call is sent.
